mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above the prior 5-quarter average coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5-quarter moving average in the same month as a negative 5-day SPX return
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, the 20-day forward return is not statistically different from the pre-rate hike period (t-test p > 0.1), or the 5-quarter moving average crossover does not precede the SPX return by more than 3 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in manufacturing production (INDPRO) signals weakening labor market strength and impending market volatility, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% in a month when INDPRO falls by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: Over 12 such triggered events, the 20-day forward return is non-negative in >50% of cases, or the correlation between PAYEMS/INDPRO change and SPX return is < -0.2.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be positive as the market anticipates a possible rate cut cycle.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3% and remains above for ≥2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In 20 such inflation spikes, the 20-day forward return is negative in >50% of cases, or the 5-day SPX reaction to the CPI crossing is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) followed by a rebound above the prior month's level predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates economic stabilization.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO drops by >5% in one month and recovers to >90% of prior month's value in the following month
failure_condition: Over 10 such recovery cycles, the 60-day forward return is negative in >40% of cases, or the 30-day SPX reaction lags the production signal by more than 10 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months indicate a labor market tightening that precedes a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE remains below 4% for ≥3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Across 15 such periods, the 20-day forward return is not positive in >70% of cases, or the 5-day SPX reaction does not precede the UNRATE trend by ≤2 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in payrolls (PAYEMS) and a sustained decline in retail sales (not available in catalog—skip) → instead, a surge in payrolls (PAYEMS) and a sustained decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return due to over-heating labor markets and weak demand.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >5% for two consecutive months while INDPRO falls by >3% in the same months
regime_hint: Overheating labor market with weak manufacturing
failure_condition: Over 8 such events, the 5-day forward return is not negative in >75% of cases, or the correlation between PAYEMS decline and INDPRO drop and SPX return is > 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals deteriorating housing market conditions and broader demand weakness, leading to a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
Note: Since direct demand proxies are missing, using HOUST as a weak demand/sentiment proxy. This is a valid fallback for the exercise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls by >10% in a single month
failure_condition: Over 12 such HOUST drops, the 60-day forward return is not negative in >60% of cases, or the 30-day SPX reaction to the drop is not statistically significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to a supply-side easing (lower industrial production volatility) characterized by a low-frequency trend in INDPRO volatility below its 5-year median, predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as market expects future supply-side easing.
candidate_trigger: Rolling 30-day volatility of INDPRO falls below its 5-year median for ≥4 consecutive months
regime_hint: Low volatility regime in supply chain activity
failure_condition: Across 10 such volatility regimes, the 20-day forward return is negative in >50% of cases, or the 5-day SPX reaction to the volatility regime change is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
